query: Patient data incident intake form sections

candidates.content: Incident intake: discovery time, systems affected, data categories, individuals impacted, containment steps, notification owners.
Vendor BAA review checklist: permitted uses, safeguards, breach notice windows, subcontractors, return/destruction of PHI/ePHI.
Privacy notice outline: controller identity, purposes, lawful basis, retention, rights, contact channel.
Surgical technique videos are for clinician training only.
Hospital cafeteria menu rotates weekly vegetarian options.
